answer_1.quote: we propose lightweight (<300M parameters), task-specific models for structuring free-text chest X-ray radiology reports

answer_2.quote: To assess both linguistic quality and clinical accuracy, we use a combination of lexical and radiology-specific metrics. Lexical Metrics To ensure comprehensive evaluation of text quality, we apply the following metrics: BLEU measures n-gram overlap... ROUGE-L evaluates the longest common subsequence... BERTScore computes semantic similarity... To capture clinical accuracy, we apply the following metrics: F1-RadGraph evaluates the precision and recall of key clinical terms... GREEN assesses the factual correctness... F1-SRRG-Bert [...]

answer_3.quote: GREEN assesses the factual correctness of generated radiology reports using a fine-tuned LLM.

answer_4.quote: Five board-certified radiologists from our institution reviewed the structured reports alongside their original free-form counterparts, assessing them for errors and adherence to our predefined template
answer_4.guideline: Assessing for errors and adherence to predefined template
